description: Reads the Uniswap v4 positions a wallet opened through Earn, LoomDesk's earlier stock-pool product, which takes no new positions. Use only for a wallet known to have used Earn; for positions today use my_ladders, and to provide liquidity use plan_build or plan_ladder. Returns: address, positions[] with tokenId, symbol, pool, tickLower, tickUpper, inRange, valueUsdg, uncollectedUsdg, feeWeekly; an empty list for a wallet that never used Earn. Behavior: read-only, cached 15 seconds per wallet; costs 1 unit. Errors: refused when the address is malformed; a wallet with nothing returns empty lists.
name: my_positions
title: A wallet's Earn positions (legacy)
